findings.evidence: src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts calls prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } }) and prisma.user.create({ data: { email, password: hash, name } }), reading and writing a User table with email/password/name fields.
findings.locationHint: | PlannedItem (via Prisma) | Planned items read/written by `src/app/api/plans/[planId]/items/route.ts` (`title`, `amountCents`, `categoryId`, `note`, `planId`). |
findings.message: The Data Storage table lists only Plan and PlannedItem but omits the User table, even though `src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts` (a listed input) directly reads and writes `prisma.user` records (email, password, name).
